<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="3773" dy="2825" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml DogApp
 hide circle
 skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
 skinparam linetype ortho
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle

 ' ===================== ENUMS =====================
 package \"Enums\" {
 enum Sex {
 MALE
 FEMALE
 }
 enum DogSize {
 SMALL
 MEDIUM
 LARGE
 GIANT
 }
 enum Temperament {
 FRIENDLY
 PLAYFUL
 SHY
 REACTIVE
 }
 enum EventType {
 PLAYDATE
 GROUP_WALK
 BREED_MEETUP
 }
 enum Visibility {
 PUBLIC
 PRIVATE
 }
 enum RsvpStatus {
 GOING
 MAYBE
 NOT_GOING
 }
 enum HealthRecordType {
 VACCINE
 DEWORMING
 VET_VISIT
 WEIGHT
 }
 enum PlaceType {
 PARK
 DOG_PARK
 CAFE
 VET
 PET_SHOP
 }
 enum PlaceSource {
 OSM
 USER_EVENTS
 }
 }

 ' ===================== CORE =====================
 package \"Core (1. Search)\" {
 class User {
 +id: Int
 +email: String <<unique>>
 +passwordHash: String
 +emailVerified: Boolean
 +firstName: String
 +lastName: String
 +avatarUrl: String?
 +bio: String?
 +approxLatitude: Float
 +approxLongitude: Float
 +createdAt: DateTime
 }

 class Dog {
 +id: Int
 +name: String
 +birthDate: DateTime
 +sex: Sex
 +size: DogSize
 +temperament: Temperament
 +photoUrl: String?
 +ownerId: Int
 +breedId: Int
 }

 class Breed {
 +id: Int
 +name: String <<unique>>
 +size: DogSize
 +energyLevel: Int (1-5)
 +careTips: String
 +heatSensitive: Boolean
 +breathingIssues: Boolean
 }
 }

 ' ===================== SOCIAL =====================
 package \"2. Social\" {
 class Post {
 +id: Int
 +authorId: Int
 +content: String
 +imageUrl: String?
 +createdAt: DateTime
 }

 class Like {
 +userId: Int
 +postId: Int
 +createdAt: DateTime
 --
 <<unique (userId, postId)>>
 }

 class Comment {
 +id: Int
 +userId: Int
 +postId: Int
 +content: String
 +createdAt: DateTime
 }

 class Conversation {
 +id: Int
 +createdAt: DateTime
 }

 class ConversationParticipant {
 +conversationId: Int
 +userId: Int
 +joinedAt: DateTime
 }

 class Message {
 +id: Int
 +conversationId: Int
 +senderId: Int
 +content: String
 +sentAt: DateTime
 +readAt: DateTime?
 }
 }

 ' ===================== EVENTS =====================
 package \"3. Events\" {
 class Event {
 +id: Int
 +organizerId: Int
 +placeId: Int?
 +title: String
 +description: String?
 +type: EventType
 +visibility: Visibility
 +startsAt: DateTime
 +endsAt: DateTime
 +maxParticipants: Int?
 }

 class EventParticipant {
 +eventId: Int
 +userId: Int
 +dogId: Int
 +status: RsvpStatus
 }
 }

 ' ===================== CARE =====================
 package \"4. Care\" {
 class HealthRecord {
 +id: Int
 +dogId: Int
 +type: HealthRecordType
 +date: DateTime
 +nextDueDate: DateTime?
 +weightKg: Float?
 +notes: String?
 }
 }

 ' ===================== MAP =====================
 package \"5. Map (optional)\" {
 class Place {
 +id: Int
 +name: String
 +latitude: Float
 +longitude: Float
 +address: String?
 +phone: String?
 +website: String?
 +openingHours: String?
 +type: PlaceType
 +source: PlaceSource
 }

 class PlaceReview {
 +id: Int
 +userId: Int
 +placeId: Int
 +eventId: Int
 +rating: Int (1-5)
 +tags: String[]
 +createdAt: DateTime
 }
 }

 ' ===================== RELATIONS =====================
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Dog : owns >
 Breed \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Dog : < is of

 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Post : writes >
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Like
 Post \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Like
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Comment
 Post \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Comment

 Conversation \"1\" -- \"2..*\" ConversationParticipant
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ConversationParticipant
 Conversation \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Message
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Message : sends >

 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Event : organizes >
 Event \"1\" -- \"0..*\" EventParticipant
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" EventParticipant
 Dog \"1\" -- \"0..*\" EventParticipant
 Place \"0..1\" -- \"0..*\" Event : hosts >

 Dog \"1\" -- \"0..*\" HealthRecord

 Place \"1\" -- \"0..*\" PlaceReview
 User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" PlaceReview
 Event \"1\" -- \"0..*\" PlaceReview : after >

 @enduml",
 "config": null
